card.name: Word just before a number or ordinal
card.fires_on: Words or spaces that come right before an expected number or ordinal, such as 'third' before trimester, a space before a digit, or part of 'parturition'. Setting is mostly drug-label timing and pregnancy text.

modes.label: Ordinal before a period
modes.description: Ordinal words like third or first that lead into a named period or item.

modes.label: Space before a number
modes.description: A blank space token just ahead of a numeral in a percentage or hour count.

modes.label: Inside a word or year
modes.description: A partial word or digit in the middle of a longer word or year.

card.plain: It fires on small pieces of text that sit just before a number, like a space before a digit or the word third before trimester.
